deploy-bot: starting rollout of model:v3.2-weightset-2026 to 10% traffic in eu-west-1
incident-bot: paging oncall @eric-oncall — anomaly detection: 15x increase in invalid-token responses from v3.2 canary :rotating_light:
eric-oncall: ack — looking now
kevin-ml: seeing garbled completions and OOV token spikes on evaluation traces. sample: "�ĸ� response tokens". low latency but nonsensical outputs.
maria-sre: any deploy logs? who promoted weights to prod artifact tag?
deploy-bot: promotion event: ci-2026-04-11::promote -> model:v3.2-weightset-2026 by jamal-eng
jamal-eng: I did a staged promote after CI pass. there was a downstream packaging step that reindexed offsets — suspect mismatch with tokenizer config.
lisa-runtime: confirming: runtime served weightset with vocab_offset=128 but tokenizer config in artifact expects base_offset=0. prefix cache not invalidated on rollout.
alice-support: we have 4 customers in eu-west-1 reporting garbled outputs in prod chat flows — one escalated to P1 since it impacted billing flows.
eric-oncall: impact unacceptable. flip routing flag to force traffic back to stable v3.1 now — maria, can you flip feature flag model-route to v3.1 for eu-west-1?
maria-sre: flipping feature flag model-route=stable(v3.1) for eu-west-1. applying kill-switch for promoted weightset. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: rollback initiated to artifact model:v3.1-weightset-2025 across eu-west-1
jamal-eng: rolling back also publishes a token-sync job to invalidate prefix/KV cache. running: `kubectl -n runtime exec token-sync -- /app/sync --invalidate-prefix`
kevin-ml: post-rollback sanity: sample requests now return coherent tokens. tokenizer mismatch appears to be root cause (weights packaged with old vocab mapping). adding package check to release pipeline.
alice-support: notifying affected customers with summary: temporary regressions during rollout; traffic routed to stable version; ETA for full postmortem: 2 business days.
eric-oncall: handing off to lisa-runtime and jamal-eng for postmortem + remediation. I'll file the incident ticket and capture timeline.
incident-bot: created incident INC-2026-213 in PagerDuty and Slack channel #incidents. severity: high. responders: jamal-eng, lisa-runtime, kevin-ml, maria-sre
jamal-eng: immediate next steps: (1) block artifact promotions without tokenizer hash match (2) add pre-deploy diff check for vocab offsets (3) add canary traffic slow-start from 0.1% -> 1% -> 10% with validation checks
lisa-runtime: will follow up with hotfix pipeline PR to fail rollout on mismatch and add a canary validator that runs a small prompt suite.
eric-oncall: thanks all. documenting handoff in the incident ticket. :thumbsup:
